content: microsoft/harrier-oss-v1-0.6b official card: 1024-dim, 32768 ctx, decoder-only last-token pooling + L2 norm, MIT, ~94 languages. Queries MUST carry instruction: model.encode(queries, prompt_name='web_search_query') (also sts_query/bitext_query); documents get NO instruction; omitting query instruction causes performance degradation. Similarity = matmul*100. Card has NO GGUF/llama.cpp guidance. Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B card: also 1024 (MRL 32-1024), last-token, prompt_name='query', 1-5% retrieval drop without query instruct; same width => width-only guard cannot distinguish the two models.
